I design and run observational studies on data that was collected for administration and public health operations, not for research. Most of my work involves getting several imperfect sources to agree on the same person, the same event, and the same time window, then stating plainly what the resulting estimate can and cannot support. I work at a state health department on overdose, injury, and mortality surveillance, and my doctoral research was in occupational and environmental epidemiology.

Multi-source overdose and injury surveillance for a state of roughly two million people, spanning prescription drug monitoring, EMS, hospital discharge, and vital records.

## Where to start

If you have five minutes, read the [RWE protocol and notebook](work/rwe.qmd). It shows how I state a question, define a cohort, choose a comparison, and describe what would break the estimate.
